claims.statement: For the supplied nonidentity P in G1 and uniform z in GT with z=e(P,Q0)^a under the pinned pairing convention, recover Q=[a]Q0 in G2 with e(P,Q)=z. The squaring-class mixed add/square rho of proof.md succeeds with probability at least 0.45 using at most 2^126.4911 total target-group-operation equivalents, including preprocessing, collision detection, output and attack-side verification. Peak memory is at most 2^134.402 bytes; preprocessing is at most 2^20 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in total work; nonuniform advice is at most 2^0 bytes and is included in memory. This is a classical cold attack with no uncharged advice and no quantum steps; the only heuristic is the standard rho randomness of the block map, and the declared exponential memory is required.

experiments.purpose: Check, in a small prime-order subgroup of F_p^*, that the fourteen disjoint ratio classes per block pair are all detected by storing every emitted element, and that the birthday success model matches observation. Small-scope evidence only: it does not establish BLS12-381 costs, Fp12 arithmetic or production complexity.
